en.name: Gudiao
en.ability: Each night, choose left or right: you learn the character of next alive good player in that direction, they are poisoned and register as evil Gudiao until dusk.

zh.name: 蛊雕
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择左或右：你得知该方向上的下一名存活善良玩家的角色，他中毒且其他善良玩家以为他是邪恶的蛊雕，直到下个黄昏。
